captions.detailed: A classic upright arcade cabinet featuring a tall, boxy black wooden silhouette. The lower half consists of a large rectangular base, and the upper half features a recessed screen and an angled control panel deck. The control deck is populated with colorful red, blue, and yellow action buttons alongside a red ball-top joystick. The joystick can tilt freely on a central gimbal, and a lower cashbox door on the front face rotates on a vertical hinge.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a classic upright arcade machine with a boxy black cabinet, an angled screen, and a wide control panel deck. Include a red ball-top joystick that tilts on a gimbal joint and a hinged cashbox door below the screen.
captions.factory: Construct the main cabinet base and upper housing using Box primitives. Create the angled screen and control deck using rotated Box shapes. Model the joystick using a Cylinder for the shaft and a Sphere for the red ball-top, then attach it using a floating or spherical joint to simulate a gimbal. Model the cashbox door as a flat Box and attach it to the lower cabinet using a revolute joint along its vertical edge.
